issue.title: Regression: `macsec/test_docker_restart.py` preventing run_tests.py from running on T2 without a macsec enabled node.

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Previous Working Version

Prior to https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/18518 merging

### Steps to Reproduce

Run run_tests.py on a T2 device with no macsec enabled nodes and the `pytest_generate_tests` will fail with:
`sudo ./run_tests.sh -n ardut -c test_pretest.py -x -e '--pdb'`
`ERROR macsec/test_docker_restart.py - AssertionError: Test selected require at-least one macsec node, none of the DUTs`

This is the assertion line:
```
assert len(frontend_duts) > 0, \
    "Test selected require at-least one {} node, " \
    "none of the DUTs '{}' in testbed '{}' are a {} node".format(host_type, duts, tbname, host_type)
```

From PDB I can see that it's this function check which prevents the node from being added to `frontend_duts`:
```
(Pdb) is_macsec_capable_node(inv_files, dut)
False
```

### Impact of this regression

Can't run `run_tests.sh` on a T2 without macsec enabled unless I first revert https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/18518
